name: Scenario Switch
summary: Segmented control (Base / Upside / Downside) with a sliding indicator that sets a scenario filter or a shared state key for the whole report.
summary_zh: 带滑动指示条的分段切换控件（基准 / 乐观 / 悲观），为整份报告设置情景筛选或共享状态。
description_zh: 用于管理层计划、DCF、LBO 等多情景页面：点击或用方向键切换情景，所有绑定了含情景字段数据集的图表会同步刷新。filter 模式在 RK.store 中设置 {field, op:'in', values:[情景]} 筛选；state 模式只写入一个状态键（RK.store.set），供声明了 listens 的组件自行读取。挂载时若尚未设置则自动应用默认情景，被外部清除时会恢复默认值，保证页面始终只展示一个情景。可在每个选项下显示该情景的关键数字（如 2028E EBITDA），并用说明文字解释情景假设。
best_for: Management plan Base / Upside / Downside toggles
avoid_when: More than ~5 options (use a filter-bar select)
Several values must be compared side by side (chart them instead)

field.desc: Scenario field in the bound dataset (option 'field')
Dataset field holding the scenario names; also the default store key

values.desc: Explicit option order; null = distinct values of the bound dataset in data order (fallback Base / Upside / Downside)

descriptions.desc: {value: caption} shown under the control for the active case

default.desc: Case applied on mount when the store has none (null = first value)

mode.desc: filter: RK.store.setFilter(key, {field, op:'in', values:[v]}) | state: RK.store.set(key, v)

key.desc: Store key (filter key or state key); defaults to the field name

label.desc: Small-caps label; defaults to the field title

tones.desc: Status dot colour: 'auto' (Upside = positive, Downside = negative), false, or {value: 'pos'|'neg'|'base'}

metric.desc: {field, agg, where, format, label, compare} headline value per case; agg defaults to sum, compare (default true) adds the % change vs. the default case, e.g. {field:'ebitda', where:'year == "2028E"', format:'$#,##0"m"', label:'EBITDA 2028E'}

interactions: Click or arrow keys to switch case (radio group, roving focus)
Drives every block bound to a dataset with the scenario field
Re-applies the default case if the filter is cleared elsewhere
Metric values respect the other global filters

descriptions.Base: Management plan: 6.6% revenue CAGR 2025A–30E, EBITDA margin expanding to 20.5%.
descriptions.Upside: Accelerated automation demand: 8.8% revenue CAGR, 22.0% EBITDA margin by 2030E.
descriptions.Downside: Industrial slowdown: 3.2% revenue CAGR, margins flat at c.18.5%.
